# FortiGate (FortiOS) conversion from PAN-OS
config system global
    set hostname "PA-EDGE-01"
end
# ---- Interfaces
config system interface
    edit "port1"
        set vdom "root"
        set mode dhcp
    next
    edit "port2"
        set vdom "root"
        set mode static
        set ip 10.10.0.1 255.255.255.0
        config secondaryip
            edit 1
                set ip 10.10.1.1 255.255.255.0
            next
        end
    next
    edit "port3"
        set vdom "root"
        set mode static
        set ip 10.20.0.1 255.255.255.0
    next
    edit "agg2"
        set vdom "root"
        set type aggregate
        set member "port4" "port5"
        set lacp-mode passive
        set mode static
        set ip 10.30.0.1 255.255.255.0
    next
    edit "agg3"
        set vdom "root"
        set type aggregate
        # set member <ports>
        set lacp-mode static
        set mode static
        set ip 10.31.0.1 255.255.255.0
    next
    edit "lo5"
        set vdom "root"
        set type loopback
        set mode static
        set ip 10.255.5.5 255.255.255.255
    next
end
# ---- Site-to-site VPN
config vpn ipsec phase1-interface
    edit "tunA"
        set interface "port1"
        set ike-version 1
        set proposal aes128-sha1
        set dhgrp 2
        set type dynamic
        set peertype any
        set mode aggressive
        set keylife 172800
        set nattraversal disable
        set dpd disable
        set psksecret REPLACE-ME
    next
    edit "tunB"
        # set interface <outgoing port>
        set ike-version 2
        set proposal aes256-sha256
        set remote-gw 203.0.113.77
        set keylife 86400
        set nattraversal disable
        set dpd disable
        set psksecret REPLACE-ME
    next
end
config vpn ipsec phase2-interface
    edit "tunA-p2-1"
        set phase1name "tunA"
        set proposal aes128-sha1 3des-sha1
        set pfs disable
        set keylifeseconds 5400
        set src-subnet 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0
        set dst-subnet 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0
    next
    edit "tunB-p2-1"
        set phase1name "tunB"
        set proposal aes256-sha256
        set pfs disable
        set keylifeseconds 43200
        set src-subnet 10.20.0.0 255.255.255.0
        set dst-subnet 10.60.0.0 255.255.255.0
    next
end
# ---- Zones
config system zone
    edit "outside"
        set intrazone allow
        set interface "port1"
    next
    edit "inside"
        set intrazone allow
        set interface "port2" "port3"
    next
    edit "core"
        set intrazone allow
        set interface "agg2"
    next
    edit "vpn"
        set intrazone allow
        set interface "tunA" "tunB"
    next
    edit "tapz"
        set intrazone allow
    next
end
# ---- Objects
config firewall address
    edit "h1"
        set subnet 10.20.0.5 255.255.255.255
    next
    edit "r1"
        set type iprange
        set start-ip 10.20.0.10
        set end-ip 10.20.0.20
    next
    edit "w1"
        set type wildcard
        set wildcard 10.0.0.0 0.255.0.255
    next
    edit "f1"
        set type fqdn
        set fqdn "files.example.test"
    next
    edit "inner-group-member"
        set subnet 10.20.1.0 255.255.255.0
    next
end
config firewall addrgrp
    edit "inner"
        set member "h1" "inner-group-member"
    next
    edit "outer"
        set member "inner" "r1"
    next
end
config firewall service custom
    edit "s-udp"
        set udp-portrange 5060
    next
    edit "app-ntp"
        set udp-portrange 123
        set comment "default ports of the PAN-OS application ntp"
    next
end
config firewall service group
    edit "both"
        set member "s-udp"
    next
end
config firewall ippool
    edit "pool-n-static"
        set type one-to-one
        set startip 203.0.113.10
        set endip 203.0.113.10
    next
end
# ---- Firewall policy
config firewall policy
    edit 1
        set name "r-users"
        set srcintf "inside"
        set dstintf "outside"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL"
        set logtraffic all
        set status disable
        set comments "NOT ENABLED: user / group match; source rule r-users"
    next
    edit 2
        set name "r-cat"
        set srcintf "inside"
        set dstintf "outside"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action deny
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL"
        set logtraffic all
        set status disable
        set comments "NOT ENABLED: URL category; source rule r-cat"
    next
    edit 3
        set name "r-sched"
        set srcintf "inside"
        set dstintf "outside"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL"
        set logtraffic all
        set status disable
        set comments "NOT ENABLED: schedule worktime; source rule r-sched"
    next
    edit 4
        set name "r-hip"
        set srcintf "inside"
        set dstintf "outside"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL"
        set logtraffic all
        set status disable
        set comments "NOT ENABLED: HIP profile; source rule r-hip"
    next
    edit 5
        set name "r-prof"
        set srcintf "inside"
        set dstintf "outside"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL"
        set logtraffic all
        set comments "source rule r-prof"
    next
    edit 6
        set name "r-appany"
        set srcintf "inside"
        set dstintf "outside"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL"
        set logtraffic all
        set status disable
        set comments "NOT ENABLED: application-default for any application; source rule r-appany"
    next
    edit 7
        set name "r-appsvc"
        set srcintf "inside"
        set dstintf "outside"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
        set service "DNS" "app-ntp"
        set logtraffic all
        set status disable
        set comments "NOT ENABLED: application unknown-app-xyz (App-ID); PAN-OS applications: dns, ntp, unknown-app-xyz; source rule r-appsvc"
    next
    edit 8
        set name "r-appsvc2"
        set srcintf "inside"
        set dstintf "outside"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action accept
        set schedule "always"
        set service "s-udp"
        set logtraffic all
        set status disable
        set comments "NOT ENABLED: application dns; PAN-OS applications: dns; source rule r-appsvc2"
    next
    edit 9
        set name "r-neg"
        set srcintf "inside"
        set dstintf "outside"
        set srcaddr "h1"
        set dstaddr "outer" "f1" "w1"
        set action deny
        set schedule "always"
        set service "both"
        set logtraffic all
        set srcaddr-negate enable
        set dstaddr-negate enable
        set status disable
        set comments "negated; NOT ENABLED: address bad1 not converted; source rule r-neg"
    next
    edit 10
        set name "r-weird"
        set srcintf "inside"
        set dstintf "outside"
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set action deny
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL"
        set logtraffic all
        set comments "source rule r-weird"
    next
end
config firewall central-snat-map
    edit 1
        set type ipv4
        set status enable
        set srcintf "inside"
        set dstintf "outside"
        set orig-addr "h1"
        set dst-addr "all"
        set nat enable
        set nat-ippool "pool-n-static"
    next
end
config system settings
    set central-nat enable
end
# ---- Routing
config router static
    edit 1
        set dst 10.90.0.0 255.255.0.0
        set gateway 10.10.0.254
        set device "port2"
        set distance 30
        set priority 7
    next
end
config router bgp
    set as 65100
    set router-id 10.255.5.5
    config neighbor
        edit "10.10.0.2"
            set remote-as 65200
            set description "g1"
        next
        edit "10.10.0.3"
            set remote-as 65200
            set description "g1"
        next
        # neighbor 10.10.0.4: peer-as is not in the configuration; add `edit 10.10.0.4` / `set remote-as <AS>`
    end
end
config router ospf
    set router-id 10.255.5.5
    config area
        edit 0.0.0.1
        next
    end
    config network
        edit 1
            set prefix 10.30.0.0 255.255.255.0
            set area 0.0.0.1
        next
        edit 2
            set prefix 10.10.0.0 255.255.255.0
            set area 0.0.0.1
        next
        edit 3
            set prefix 10.10.1.0 255.255.255.0
            set area 0.0.0.1
        next
    end
end
